newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: McCully to take Banks' portfolios in NZ govt.
newsitem.headline: McCully to take Banks' portfolios in NZ govt.

text.p: New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger on Friday accepted the resignation of cabinet minister John Banks and said in a statement that Housing Minister Murray McCully would take over his portfolios in the caretaker government.
Banks, responsible for tourism, sport, local government and civil defence, said he was leaving to concentrate on social issues and other interests including broadcasting.
